x-codeSamples.source:
# To use the Python SDK, install the package:
# pip install evermemos

from evermemos import EverMemOS

memory = EverMemOS(api_key="<api_key>").v0.memories

response = memory.add(
    message_id="<message_id>",
    create_time="<iso8601_time>",
    sender="<user_id>",
    content="<message_content>"
)
print(response.status, response.request_id)

scene.title: Scene
scene.description:
Scene identifier.

Enum values from ScenarioType:
- assistant: Ideal for personal assistants, AI companion or multi-party chats centered on the primary user.
- group_chat: Tailored for group syncs and professional teamwork. It extracts independent, granular memories for every participant.

scene_desc.title: Scene Desc
scene_desc.description:
Scene description object.

Can include fields like description, type, etc.

llm_custom_setting.description:
LLM custom settings for algorithm control.

Allows configuring different LLM providers/models for different tasks like boundary detection and memory extraction.

examples: Technical discussion for new feature development

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Conversation creation time (ISO 8601 format with Timezone is required)

user_details.title: User Details
user_details.description: Participant details, key is user ID, value is user detail object

user_details.title: User Details
user_details.description: New user details (will completely replace existing user_details)

examples.summary: Update group config - can update name
Update global config - can update scene_desc, llm_custom_setting

group_id.title: Group Id
group_id.description: Group ID. If not provided, will automatically generate based on hash(sender) + '_group' suffix, representing single-user mode where each user's messages are extracted into separate memory spaces.

create_time.title: Create Time
create_time.description: Message creation time (ISO 8601 format with Timezone is required)

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: Sender user ID (required). Also used as user_id internally for memory ownership.

sender_name.title: Sender Name
sender_name.description: Sender name (uses sender if not provided)

role.title: Role
role.description:
Message sender role, used to identify the source of the message.
Enum values from MessageSenderRole:
- user: Message from a human user
- assistant: Message from an AI assistant

content.title: Content
examples: Let's discuss the technical solution for the new feature today

flush.title: Flush
flush.description: Force boundary trigger. When True, immediately triggers memory extraction instead of waiting for natural boundary detection.

value.content: Let's discuss the technical solution for the new feature today

found.title: Found
found.description: Whether the request status was found

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: Whether this is the global (default) config

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: List of filter types used for deletion

group_ids.title: Group Ids
group_ids.description: List of Group IDs for batch query. Single group also needs array format. Max 50.

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Number of records per page, default 20, max 100

memory_type.description:
Memory type, enum values from MemoryType:
- profile: user profile
- episodic_memory: episodic memory (default)
- foresight: prospective memory
- event_log: event log (atomic facts)

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: Start time for time range filtering (ISO 8601 format with Timezone is required)

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: End time for time range filtering (ISO 8601 format with Timezone is required)

total_count.title: Total Count
total_count.description: Total number of records matching query conditions (for pagination calculation)

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of records in current page (length of memories array)

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: User ID (at least one of user_id or group_id must be provided)

memory_types.title: Memory Types
memory_types.description:
List of memory types to retrieve, enum values from MemoryType:
- profile: user profile (Milvus vector search only)
- episodic_memory: episodic memory
- foresight: prospective memory (not yet supported for search)
- event_log: event log (not yet supported for search)
Note: Only profile and episodic_memory are supported. Defaults to both if not specified.

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: Time range start (ISO 8601 format with Timezone is required). Only applies to episodic_memory, ignored for profile

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: Time range end (ISO 8601 format with Timezone is required). Only applies to episodic_memory, ignored for profile

retrieve_method.description:
Retrieval method, enum values from RetrieveMethod:
- keyword: keyword retrieval (BM25, default)
- vector: vector semantic retrieval
- hybrid: hybrid retrieval (keyword + vector)
- rrf: RRF fusion retrieval (keyword + vector + RRF ranking fusion)
- agentic: LLM-guided multi-round intelligent retrieval

current_time.title: Current Time
current_time.description: Current time, used to filter forward-looking events within validity period

radius.title: Radius
radius.description: COSINE similarity threshold for vector retrieval (only for vector and hybrid methods, default 0.6)

top_k.title: Top K
top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return. -1 means return all results that meet the threshold (up to 100). Valid values: -1 or 1-100.

group_ids.title: Group Ids
group_ids.description: Array of Group IDs to search (max 10 items). None means search all groups for the user.
